semantics.observer: FRA logical nonplayer; physical player country may differ.
semantics.bankruptcy_risk: planned; retain unknown until a separate read-only formula and permission source is proven.
semantics.loan_amounts: The legacy observer-lent subset remains independent; target principal is available only through the separate target_debt_principal scope.
semantics.income_and_payments: prior-month cache projection; not current contracts, outgoing obligations, or a guarantee of UI display.
semantics.observer_reparations: Private FRA-own-economy relationship for the explicit FRA/target pair only. Does not authorize all target contracts, establish F03 target visibility, or infer a current payment obligation or amount. The legacy reparations receipt remains the previous-month income-comparison cache.
semantics.target_debt_principal: The public amount is the target loan-list diplomatic principal sum using signed32(principal*1000) and signed32 accumulation; it excludes remaining interest and does not assert action execution or current repayment obligation.
semantics.target_debt_disclosure: The native AI-accept selector is admitted only after the stock predicate or the exact installed v33 GUI-forwarding subset is dynamically matched; the hooked code is checked as a bounded body/header/global subset, not as a whole loaded DLL. Native executor validity, favors, diplomats, and cooldown remain outside the read gate.
semantics.native_choice_mapping: Accept only the stock native-true predicate or one of the individually pinned v34, v41 CallAction, and v41 expiry-build GUI-forwarding hooks. Record the actual asset identity and replay every guarded byte and global. Scope remains the guarded native GUI caller.
semantics.debt_projection_routing: The v7 public entry selects the total-principal projector only by the exact private permission schema: v2 goes to the pinned v2 projector, v3 to the pinned v34 projector; unknown schemas fail closed. The v6 profile and projector remain separate and unchanged.

limitations: This static profile build did not observe a process or read runtime memory.
It does not call native functions or prove current cache freshness, UI rendering, or an atomic frame snapshot.
Bankruptcy risk remains planned and unknown; static action/caller evidence is not a forecast formula.
Income cache entries for subsidies and reparations describe prior-month received values, not proof of active contracts or zero outgoing amounts.
The loan reader observes only exact observer-lender matches; it does not establish total debt.
The public target_debt_principal amount uses the native diplomatic principal arithmetic; it excludes remaining interest and payoff quotes.
Native AI-accept selector visibility does not prove a rendered UI, action execution, or current payment obligation.
The required-diplomat helper and action exclusion table are bounded static guards; runtime admission still uses a fresh validated selector scope and parent context checks.
The installed v33 hook is accepted only when its exact callback bytes, PE header subset, game-base global, and saved native predicate pointer match the pinned mapping contract.
The mapping contract validates a matched loaded-DLL subset and does not verify the whole loaded DLL hash.
The hook audit establishes installation and bounded control flow, not actual callback execution or UI rendering in the profiled session.

installed_v34_gui_forwarding_subset.proof_scope: For native GUI callers within the guarded refresh function, the special daily-AI caller check is false; the favor-gold vtable path calls its saved original predicate. This is not a general claim that the hook always returns true.
